7,311 likes, 49 comments - fit.khurana on October 30, 2026: "Recipe ⬇️ (10 Pieces | ~99 Cals | ~10.8g Protein per piece)

📝 Ingredients
🥛 700ml Amul Toned Milk
🧀 200g iD High Protein Paneer
💪 1 scoop Mille’s unflavoured yeast protein (use my code FIT10 on www.millesupergrain.com)
🧈 1 tbsp ghee
🍬 40g zero calorie allulose sweetener
🌿 1 tsp cardamom powder
🌰 ½ tsp nutmeg powder
🧂 A pinch of salt
💧 Water as required
🍁 Maple syrup, date paste or jaggery (optional, for colour)

👨🏻‍🍳 How to Make

1. Add the milk to a pan and let it heat over medium heat.
2. Crumble the paneer into the milk and mix well.
3. Add the cardamom powder and nutmeg powder. Stir to combine.
4. Add 1 scoop of @millesupergrain Unflavoured Yeast Protein Powder and mix thoroughly.
5. In a separate pan, add the zero calorie sweetener with a little water. Let it bubble for 4 to 5 minutes until it develops a beautiful brown colour.
6. Add the browned sweetener mixture to the milk and paneer mixture and mix well.
7. Continue cooking the milk mixture, stirring frequently, for around 20 to 25 minutes until it reduces and becomes thick like milk cake.
8. Add the ghee and a pinch of salt, then mix well.
9. For a deeper colour, optionally add a little maple syrup, date paste or jaggery.
10. Transfer the mixture to a greased tray and let it cool completely until set.
11. Cut into 10 pieces and serve.

11K likes, 66 comments - fit.khurana on October 28, 2026: "Recipe ⬇️ (4 Samosas | ~680 Cals Total | ~35g Protein Total | ~18 g Fibre)

📝 Ingredients

🌯 2 whole wheat tortillas (45g each)
🌱 35g soya granules
🥔 1 medium boiled potato
🟢 ½ cup boiled green peas
🌿 1 tsp Fennel seeds
🌿 1 tsp Cumin seeds
🌿 1 tsp Coriander seeds
🌶️ 6-7 Black peppercorns
🌶️ 3 green chillies
🧄 3 garlic cloves
🌿 A handful of kasuri methi
🧂 Salt and black salt to taste
🌶️ 1 tsp black pepper
🌶️ 1 tsp garam masala
🍋 ½ tsp Aamchur powder
🫒 1 tsp oil
🌽 Cornflour slurry for sealing
🌿 Green chutney for serving

👨🏻‍🍳 How to Make

1. Add the fennel seeds, cumin seeds, coriander seeds and black peppercorns to a mortar and pestle. Crush coarsely.
2. Heat 1 tsp oil in a pan. Add the crushed whole spices and sauté until aromatic.
3. Crush the green chillies and garlic together into a coarse mixture. Add to the pan and sauté briefly.
4. Add the boiled and squeezed soya granules and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.
5. Add the boiled potato and mix well with the soya granules and spices. Add the boiled peas and sauté everything together.
6. Add the kasuri methi, garam masala, black pepper, dry mango powder, salt and black salt. Mix well.
7. Mash the mixture until it comes together, leaving some peas slightly intact.
8. Mix cornflour with a little water to make a smooth slurry for sealing.
9. Cut each tortilla in half. Add the filling in middle and fold each corner towards the mide, and seal the edges firmly with the cornflour slurry making a triangle. 
11. Spray oil on top and Air-fry at 160°C for 7 to 10 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crispy.
12. Serve hot with green chutney.

whole wheat samosa, soya samosa, high protein samosa, air fryer samosa, healthy Indian snacks, soya granules recipe, vegetarian snack, tortilla samosa, crispy samosa, healthy evening snack, protein rich vegetarian food, healthy street food, healthy samosa".

22K likes, 97 comments - fit.khurana on October 26, 2026: "Recipe ( ~450 Cals, ~40g Protein) ⬇️

Ingredients

• 2 slices Double Protein Bread
• 80-90 g ID High Protein Paneer 
• 1 tbsp peri peri masala
• 1 tsp sesame seeds
• Oil spray (2–3 sprays)
• 4-6 cucumber slices
• 2 beetroot slices
• 3-4 tomato slices
• 1 cheese slice
• 1 tbsp Schezwan chutney
• 1 tbsp Greek yogurt
• Black pepper to taste

Method –

1️⃣ Coat the paneer evenly with peri peri masala.

2️⃣Spray a pan lightly with oil, sprinkle sesame seeds and shallow-fry the paneer on both sides until slightly crisp and golden.

3️⃣ Mix Schezwan chutney and Greek yogurt until smooth.

4️⃣ Take one bread slice, spread the sauce, add the peri peri paneer, cheese slice, cucumber, beetroot and tomato slices. Sprinkle black pepper.

5️⃣ Close the sandwich with the second bread slice and toast until crisp.

6️⃣Serve hot.

High protein meals, quick healthy recipes, vegetarian protein, healthy sandwich, high protein sandwich, balanced meals, low calorie meals".

📝 Ingredients (please feel free to cut out one slice of bread in order to reduce calories)

🥣 180g  Skyr
🫘 100g cooked chickpeas
🧀 1/2 slice cheese (optional)
🍞 2 Slices Double Protein  Bread 
🥒 1/2 cucumber
🍅 1/2 tomato
🧅 2 tbsp onion
🌱 A handful of microgreens
🌶️ Peri peri seasoning
🍋 Lemon juice
🍯 1 tsp peanut butter (optional)
🧄2 garlic cloves crushed
🧂 Salt and black pepper
🌿 Fresh coriander
🫒 A little oil
🌶️ 1/2 tsp chilli oil

2. Add one slice of cheese with a tiny splash of water and sauté for another minute until slightly cheesy. Switch off the heat. Mix skyr with lemon juice, salt, pepper, garlic, chilli oil and peanut butter.
3. Chop the cucumber, tomato and onion. Mix with lemon juice, salt, black pepper and fresh coriander to make a fresh salsa.
4. Toast the Double Protein Whole Wheat Bread until golden.
5. Assemble the Skyr in a bowl with the crispy chickpeas, fresh salsa and microgreens.
6. Serve with the toasted bread and spicy sauces of your choice.

6,503 likes, 42 comments - fit.khurana on October 17, 2026: "Recipe ⬇️ (30g Protein per serving, 520 Cals)

Ingredients ⬇️ (2 Servings) 

🧀 200g Paneer Low fat (made with toned milk)
🥛 250g High Protein Greek Yogurt
🌱 2 tbsp poppy seeds (khus khus)
🌱 1 tsp black mustard seeds
🌱 1 tsp yellow mustard seeds
🥜 7–8 cashews
🥥 ¼ cup freshly grated coconut
🌶️ 2 green chillies
💛 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
🫒 1/2 tbsp mustard oil
🧂 Salt to taste

🍃 Banana leaf for steaming

How to Make 👩🏻‍🍳

1. Soak the poppy seeds, black mustard seeds, yellow mustard seeds and cashews in warm water for 15 minutes.
2. Add the soaked ingredients to a blender along with grated coconut and a little water. Blend into a smooth paste.
3. Transfer the paste to a bowl and mix in the Greek yogurt, turmeric powder and salt until well combined.
4. Add the paneer cubes, green chillies and mustard oil. Mix everything gently until the paneer is nicely coated.
5. Line a steel container with a banana leaf, transfer the paneer mixture into it and close the lid.
6. Steam for 20 minutes until cooked. Serve hot with steamed rice and enjoy! ❤️

Bengali Paneer Bhapa, No onion garlic paneer sabzi, steamed paneer sabzi, high protein recipe, vegetarian protein, nutrition tips, balanced meal".

12K likes, 63 comments - fit.khurana on October 16, 2026: "Recipe ⬇️ (30g P, 310 Cals)

📝 Ingredients

🥣 220g Epigamia Turbo Greek Yogurt
🫐 15 to 20 blueberries
🍯 1/2 tbsp honey
🌰 2-3 walnuts chopped
🥥 Coconut chips, optional
🍋 Lemon zest
🍬 Zero calorie sweetener, to taste
🧂 A pinch of salt
✨ A pinch of cinnamon
🍯 1/2 Tbsp honey to drizzle on top 

👨🏻‍🍳 How to Make

1. Add the blueberries to a pan with zero calorie sweetener and lemon zest. Simmer for 7 to 8 minutes until the compote becomes thick and jammy, with no watery liquid remaining. Let it cool completely.
2. Mix the cooled blueberry compote into the Epigamia Turbo Protein Yogurt.
3. Transfer the mixture into a muslin cloth, tie it securely and place a heavy weight on top. Let all the excess water drain until the yogurt becomes very thick.
4. Scoop the thickened blueberry yogurt into a bowl using an ice cream scoop.
5. Dry roast the walnuts in a pan until crunchy. Add a pinch of salt and cinnamon and mix.
6. Switch off the heat, add the honey and stir for around 2 minutes until the walnuts are coated.
7. Spread the walnuts out and let them air dry for 5 to 10 minutes until crunchy.
8. Crush the honey coated walnuts and sprinkle them over the blueberry yogurt.
9. Top with coconut chips, honey and serve chilled.

#epigamiaTurbo #OGepigamia #epigamiaGreekYogurt #FarahKhan

High protein breakfast, yogurt bowl, vegetarian protein, nutrition tips, balanced meal, breakfast bowl, yogurt bowl, smoothie bowl".
